decision.observation: Reverse released the pin: gear R, 3 mph, car shifted slightly. It still sits on grass right of the lane, with the pine trunk now just to its right. Tarmac band with its line of posts runs from lower-left up to top-centre; hay bales and spectators on the far verge.
decision.hypothesis: The car is free but still off-line. The nearest tarmac is up and to the left, roughly 20% of the screen left of the car, so a sustained throttle-left hold is needed rather than a brief nudge.
decision.memory: Short 0.45s steered holds from this grass pocket stall; commit to ~0.7s when the gap to tarmac is this wide.
